resolution.method: sf-eas-addresses has 801 MARKET ST but it does not join to one parcel. 801 MARKET ST's coordinates fall in 4 active parcels (3705Z001, 3705Z002, 3705Z003, 3705Z004), which is what a condominium looks like in sf-parcels: one parcel per unit, none of them the building.
resolution.note: The address is a condominium today, and the directory contract in the root AGENTS.md defers those: each unit has its own parcel and none of them is the building the record names.
